entry.title: from scattered write-ups to one central hub

link.title: from scattered write-ups to one central hub

entry.content:
Welcome! I’m starting this blog as a single place to consolidate the project write-ups I’ve scattered across other spaces over the years.

Instead of splitting things up across different sites and formats, I want everything documented here going forward — one place to find posts and dedicated project pages for whatever I’m building.

Two projects are already written up elsewhere and will be the first to move over:

  • CNC milling machine build — designing and building my own CNC mill from scratch.
  • Outdoor kitchen — planning and building an outdoor kitchen.

More projects will follow as I finish them. Stay tuned.
